verdict.rationale: Sentry groups AI spans into sessions via `gen_ai.conversation.id` / `set_conversation_id()` and shows a User column in the Conversations view. Cost and token usage appear per LLM call and per trace, so session- and user-level attribution is partly supported. Nothing shows arbitrary custom metadata tags for features, or cost rolled up by user, session or feature. Missing for 10: feature-level attribution via custom metadata, explicit cost aggregation by user or session, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
Sentry uses the `gen_ai.conversation.id` attribute to group related AI spans
Any of `id`, `email`, or `username` is sufficient — the Conversations tab displays whichever fields are present.
